scope: Non-counted QM planning/audit claims; does not duplicate or change Core P-ID coverage

status_policy.proved: Reserved for an identified machine theorem with build and axiom receipt when machine proof is claimed.
status_policy.pending: Machine formalization not performed, even if paper proof or exact regression exists.
status_policy.paper_proof_cross_reviewed: A mathematical proof checked in this planning task; not Lean and not empirical confirmation.
status_policy.historical_declared: Read from the original research text/report; not a full independent rerun or reproof.
status_policy.proposed: An execution target with explicit assumptions and acceptance gates.
status_policy.empirical: Real data requires its own frozen protocol and validation evidence.

claims.title: v23 conservative standard quantum sector
assumptions: Given complex quantum state/effect/Born/channel/instrument/tensor structure; only object predicates added.
claims.negative_or_refusal: A definitional conservative extension has no new outcome-probability deviation.
claims.next_action: Materialize exact v23 source and formalize its declared operational adapter.

claims.title: Finite operational selection with full Nakahira background
assumptions: Full declared finite causal operational background, LE/CIT and equivalent-system purification conditions; external preprint.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Not two background-free universal axioms; no automatic infinite-dimensional extension.
claims.next_action: Freeze each background assumption and prior-art mapping; do not rename external theorem as UEOT originality.

claims.title: Instrument-adjoint observable closure and predictive quotient
claims.regression_status: 4-group suite contains exact Z and H+Z closure witness
assumptions: Finite d, time-homogeneous finite alphabet available at every step, all finite causal compositions, same policy comparison; proper reachable preparation space.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Restricted automaton/horizon requires augmented or layered closure; linear quotient need not have smaller CPTP Hilbert realization.
claims.next_action: QMB-01 through QMB-03.

claims.title: Selector without primitive/atomicity assumption
assumptions: Nc,Nf,k integers, Nc>=3, Nf>0, 0<=k<=Nf, Nf+Nc(2k-Nf)=0, Nf(Nc+1)<22.
Physics adapter: complex SU(Nc) fundamental; homogeneous lepton R template; A(R)!=0; no remaining same-channel anomaly compensation; declared active-family weak SU2 window with b2>0.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Replication satisfies the anomaly equation; weak budget excludes it. Dropping template permits a two-family local spectrum.
claims.next_action: Prove the integer theorem in Lean, then separately prove spectral and weak-window adapters.

claims.title: Generic-beta spectrum needs exotic lepton singlet completion
assumptions: Generic Dirac-completion generalized-331 class; qE=-(1+sqrt(3)*beta)/2; LH Weyl conventions.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Without Ec, grav2X has Nf*qE and X3 gains Nf*qE^3. RHN qE=0 is a special point; special field identifications must avoid double counting.
claims.next_action: Audit original verifier bytes and publish full Weyl inventory when migrating the source.

claims.title: Broader mixed-lepton template admits two-family local anomaly witness
assumptions: Nc=3,Nf=2,l=k=1,beta=0; all LH singlets including Ec; mixed 3/3bar lepton and quark representations.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Six local zeros and weak budget 8 are not global anomaly, scalar-vacuum, mass-spectrum or phenomenology certification.
claims.next_action: Keep as a permanent boundary on generic HGP-to-three claims.

claims.title: General Nc charge class removes fixed-charge color factor
claims.regression_status: Fresh L2X and X3 identities both zero
assumptions: Qu=(Nc+1)/(2Nc), Qd=-(Nc-1)/(2Nc), all completion charges adjusted; horizontal cubic cancellation; Nc nonzero.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Fixed ordinary charges and generalized charge classes are different hypotheses.
claims.next_action: Retain as charge-choice firewall in any expanded classification.

claims.title: Strong record-nondemolition Schur and semigroup classification
assumptions: Fixed orthogonal blocks; full strong SRN conditions; K PSD with diag 1; continuous time-homogeneous Schur semigroup requires Hermitian zero-diagonal CPSD generator.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Pairwise decay alone does not imply global PSD; public block records cannot distinguish J and I.
claims.next_action: Migrate and formalize finite SRN statement before expanding to process-level memory.

claims.title: Finite iid QDRR confidence contract
claims.regression_status: analytic Hoeffding-union calculation; no new sampling experiment
assumptions: m>=2, epsilon>0, 0<alpha<1; m(m-1) real settings; [-1,1] iid observations within each setting; chosen SRN class.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Correlated shots, drift, leakage, memory or unidentifiable hardware noise invalidate an unconditional mechanism claim.
claims.next_action: Freeze injection/control simulations, calibration and preregistered real-data protocol.

claims.title: Finite instrument to legal history response
assumptions: Complex finite matrices, PSD trace-one states, complete Kraus families, finite outcomes, positive probability posterior domain.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Non-complete Kraus; zero-probability branch; positive but not CP transpose.
claims.next_action: New PSD/trace/Kraus lemmas; Core probability interface.

claims.title: Effect response quotient and tomography distinction
assumptions: Legal response from QMB-01; stated effect family and measurable/continuous structures if claimed.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Z-only merges distinct states; enlarged protocol separates.
claims.next_action: M-QD and QuotientGauge after fiber compatibility.

claims.title: Future closure to reachable conditional update
assumptions: QMB-01/02; valid time/protocol closure; explicit memory/reset assumptions; subnormalized or admissible/Option totalization.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Same reduced state with different environment memory; zero-probability extension is not a physical posterior.
claims.next_action: RecursiveSufficientState and PredictionUpdate with exact types.

claims.title: Operational contraction and composable defect certificate
assumptions: Declared protocol/ancilla range and norm normalization; independent local estimates; e,epsilon,L nonnegative.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Rare postselection without success-rate bound; finite tests are not diamond control.
claims.next_action: Concrete metric contraction before M-TC specialization.

claims.title: Finite quantum Cesaro stationary limit
assumptions: Finite-dimensional CPTP map, compact density state set, continuous separating observables, residual convergence.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Identity has many stationary states; unitary orbit need not converge.
claims.next_action: Density compactness and residual adapter into M-OI.

claims.title: Diagonal CP survival map to QSD/Doob
assumptions: Fixed diagonal commutative algebra preserved by trace-nonincreasing CP map; supplied positive eigenstructure and normalizations.
claims.negative_or_refusal: General coherent/Pauli transfer is not elementwise positive; no automatic eigenvector existence or mixing.
claims.next_action: Substochastic matrix adapter into M-PE.

claims.title: Energy-constrained finite resource bridge
assumptions: H0>=0, Lambda>0, P=1_[0,Lambda)(H0), finite-rank proof, Tr(rho H0)<=E, delta<1 for normalized posterior.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Arbitrary spectral projection need not have tail <=E/Lambda; free-space cutoff need not have finite rank; exact finite CCR impossible.
claims.next_action: Prove tail bound and trace distance <=sqrt(delta), then add observation/truncation terms to M-TC.

claims.title: Typed finite regulated bridge between scale operations
assumptions: Fixed properties/target/horizon/carrier for pure Object-RG; explicit protocol lift/readout for changing protocols; selected regulated field model and matching regime.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Euclidean field integration is not automatically a real-time CPTP map.
claims.next_action: Resolve v28.1 artifacts, independently calculate both sides in one Gaussian/heavy-light model.

claims.title: Operational invariance to gauge-realization consistency bridge
assumptions: Independent full QFT anomaly theory; equivariant and connection-compatible total trivialization; matter/counterterm/inflow and global group data.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Restricted public probabilities can miss phase; local cubic cancellation is not full global consistency.
claims.next_action: Instantiate a concrete gauge realization; distinguish family factor from extended weak group.

claims.title: Heavy neutral-current universality as a template bridge
assumptions: Fixed 331 representation class, no exotic-light mixing, common Y_L; derive A,B with A!=0; full ordinary-light coupling matrix kappa*I including no offdiagonal flavor change.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Equality of diagonal couplings alone is insufficient after family rotations; no empirical universality premise established.
claims.next_action: Compute from covariant derivative, prove nondegeneracy, include mixing and representation counterexamples.

claims.title: Rank-one nonuniversal quark-current correlations
assumptions: One distinguished quark family in validated 331-like class, common other-family coupling, unitary light-family rotation, stated mediator content.
claims.negative_or_refusal: Delta_g=0 is zero signal; exotic mixing/loops/multiple mediators alter EFT mapping.
claims.next_action: Derive mediator-specific Wilson correlations and controlled corrections; fit and validate on independent data.
